s: a steep hilltop produce market that feels like the real Lyon
w: While Vieux Lyon fills with visitors, this market climbing the Croix-Rousse plateau's boulevard stays resolutely local -- outstanding seasonal produce, superb charcuterie including andouillette, cheese and flowers, sold by vendors who know their regulars by name. The neighbourhood's hidden traboule passageways thread off nearby for further wandering.
_facts: Runs along Boulevard de la Croix-Rousse on the Croix-Rousse plateau
Trades most mornings, largest on Tuesday and Sunday
Known for Lyonnais charcuterie including andouillette
Near the Croix-Rousse traboules (hidden covered passageways)
